# LinkedIn Certifications and Patents

> Send a profile URL you already have. One row returns the certifications, patents, courses, publications, and organizations.

Mawsool publishes this as an Apify Actor. Starting from $0.45 per 1,000 profiles. One charge per profile.

## Run

- Apify Actor: https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-linkedin-profile-credentials
- Call: `oday/mawsool-linkedin-profile-credentials`
- API key: https://mawsool.tech/ and https://docs.mawsool.tech/
- Contact: osama@mawsool.tech, info@mawsool.tech

## Use it when

You need the credential list, not a yes or no on one certificate.

## Use something else when

You want to know if one named certificate is on the profile. Use the Certification Checker.

## Page

- Certifications and patents from a LinkedIn profile URL: docs/linkedin-certifications-and-patents.md

Mawsool is not affiliated with LinkedIn.
